Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *dyew-
Proto-Indo-European *-ós

Proto-Indo-Iranian *daywás
Proto-Iranian *daywáh
Old Persian 𐎭𐎡𐎺 (d-i-v /⁠daivaʰ⁠⁠/)
Middle Persian 𐫅𐫏𐫇 (dyw /⁠dēw⁠/)
Persian دیو (dēw /div)bor.
Azerbaijani div
Borrowed from Persian دیو (dēw /div).
Internationalism. Borrowed from Russian ию́нь (ijúnʹ), from Old Church Slavonic июнии (ijunii), from Medieval Greek Ἰούνιος (Ioúnios), ultimately from Latin iūnius.
From Persian ورزش. Doublet of vərdiş.
